title.narrative: Social protection to provide social cohesion to Yemeni society

description.narrative: 1- Enhancing the capacity of local and community institutions to respond to shocks, risks and conflict. 2- Restoring the livelihoods of vulnerable targeted Yemenis, including internally displaced persons, persons with disabilities, and marginalized groups. 3- Strengthening local mechanisms for building peace and social cohesion.

120 displaced, marginalized and people with disabilities beneficiaries and 12 main trainers benefited from trainings on managing and resolving conflicts at the community level, improving the capacity of local authorities and community leaders to effectively respond to conflict and trauma, and resolving conflict reports by peace committees in the project's targeted districts. - 600 beneficiaries of those affected by the conflict. - 480 women / girls are direct beneficiaries of safe space activities and psychosocial support activities.

Reducing vulnerability and enhancing resilience and social cohesion of the targeted communities affected by the crisis in Yemen by creating sustainable livelihoods and promoting peacebuilding initiatives.
